privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.intro_content: BizOps ("we") values your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, and related services ("Services"). By using our Services, you consent to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. This policy is based on Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) principles.
privacy.data_collected_content: We collect several types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Services:
privacy.data_identity: Identity Data: Full name, email address, phone number, and job title.
privacy.data_business: Business Data: Company name, tax ID (NPWP), organizational structure, and operational data you input into the ERP system.
privacy.data_technical: Technical Data: IP address, browser type, operating system version, and system activity logs.
privacy.data_transaction: Transaction Data: Payment history, invoices, and subscription license details.
privacy.data_usage_content: We use the collected data to:
privacy.usage_provide: Provide, operate, and maintain our ERP Services.
privacy.usage_process: Process transactions and manage your customer account.
privacy.usage_notify: Send technical notifications, security updates, and administrative support.
privacy.usage_detect: Detect and prevent fraud or service abuse.
privacy.usage_analyze: Statistical analysis for product development (data is anonymized).
privacy.data_security_content: Your data security is our top priority. We implement strict technical and organizational security measures, including:
privacy.security_encryption: Data encryption in transit (SSL/TLS) and at rest (AES-256).
privacy.security_audit: Regular security audits and ISO 27001 certification (in progress).
privacy.security_note: However, please note that no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage method is 100% secure.
privacy.data_sharing_content: We do not sell your data to third parties. We only share data with:
privacy.sharing_subprocessors: Sub-processors: Cloud service providers (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) that support our infrastructure.
privacy.sharing_integration: Integration Partners: Third parties you choose to integrate (e.g., Payment Gateway, E-commerce), only upon your instruction.
privacy.sharing_legal: Legal Obligations: If required by law or valid court order.
privacy.your_rights_content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. Please visit our Privacy Center page to submit data subject rights (DSAR) requests.
privacy.contact_content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at: privacy@bizops.id.

Pricing.faq_1_q: Is hosting included in the subscription fee?
Pricing.faq_1_a: Yes, for Business and Growth plans, the subscription fee already includes cloud hosting costs (AWS/Google Cloud) fully managed by BizOps. You don't need to worry about separate server costs.
Pricing.faq_2_q: Are there implementation fees at the start?
Pricing.faq_2_a: Implementation fees are optional but highly recommended to ensure the system runs smoothly. We provide implementation packages starting from IDR 5 Million (Express) to IDR 25 Million (Professional). For tech-savvy users, you can do self-setup with our documentation guide for free.
Pricing.faq_3_q: What if I want to upgrade my plan midway?
Pricing.faq_3_a: You can upgrade anytime. The system will automatically calculate the pro-rata cost difference for your remaining subscription period. Your data will remain safe and there will be no downtime during the upgrade.
Pricing.faq_4_a: Very secure. We use 256-bit SSL encryption for all data transmission. Your database is automatically backed up daily to a separate server location (Disaster Recovery). For Enterprise plans, you can even choose to host data on your own server (On-Premise).
Pricing.faq_5_q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
Pricing.faq_5_a: For monthly plans, you can stop subscribing anytime before the next billing date. For annual plans, mid-period cancellation does not provide refunds, but service will remain active until the end of the subscription period.

About.hero_subheadline: BizOps was born not from speculation in a cold boardroom, but from real-life observations and frustrations on hot factory floors, busy distribution warehouses, and loud HR offices. We're here to fill that gap with precise, adaptive, and humane solutions.
About.timeline_subtitle: Our journey is not about building software, but about solving operational bottlenecks.
About.timeline_1_desc: PT Divistant Teknologi Indonesia started as a boutique software house. We saw the same failure pattern repeatedly: Indonesian companies are often forced to change their unique workflows to adapt to rigid 'imported' software logic. The result is fatal: Systems become unused 'digital monuments' (Shelfware).
About.timeline_2_desc: We refuse to compromise. We combine the power of world-class Open Source technology (Frappe Framework) with deep understanding of local nuances—such as PPh 21/23 Tax calculations, BPJS regulations, Tax Invoices, to salary advance culture. Thus BizOps was born: A system that adapts to your business, not the other way around.
About.timeline_3_desc: Our mission goes beyond just selling licenses. Our mission is Digital Sovereignty. We want every business entity in Indonesia to have full control over their own data, processes, and operational infrastructure. Free from blind dependence on foreign vendors.
About.values_subtitle: Principles that guide every line of code we write and every business decision we make.
About.value_1_manifesto: We don't chase cosmetic tech trends if they don't solve real problems. We're proud to build 'boring' solutions that work perfectly.
About.value_1_proof: Our Offline Mode feature saved coal mining operations in remote Kalimantan when satellite connection was lost.
About.value_2_manifesto: Business relationships are built on trust. No Hidden Fees, no Black Box code, and no Vendor Lock-in.
About.value_2_proof: Self-Hosted clients get full access to source code and database. You are free to conduct independent security audits anytime.
About.value_3_manifesto: Data is your strategic asset, not our commodity for trade. We reject business models that monetize user data for third parties.
About.value_3_proof: One-Click Export feature allows you to download all your data in standard format anytime. No data hostage.
About.team_subtitle: Experienced practitioners building BizOps from scratch.

Trust.hero_subtitle: We build BizOps with a "Security by Design" philosophy. Full transparency about our infrastructure, encryption, and regulatory compliance is available here.
Trust.compliance_subtitle: We are regularly audited by independent third parties to ensure the highest security standards.
Trust.security_subtitle: We don't rely on just one lock. Your data is protected by multiple security layers from physical, network, application, to data level itself.
Trust.security_1_desc: All database data is encrypted using AES-256. Data communication uses the latest TLS 1.3.
Trust.security_2_desc: Each Enterprise tenant runs in isolated containers (Virtual Private Cloud). Your data is not mixed with other clients.
Trust.security_3_desc: Our Security Operations Center (SOC) team monitors traffic anomalies and intrusion attempts in real-time.
Trust.subprocessors_subtitle: List of third-party service providers we use to process data. We minimize the number of third parties to reduce risk.
Trust.cta_subtitle: Access our complete security audit reports (Penetration Test Results & Compliance Certifications) through our dedicated Enterprise client portal.

MediaKit.boilerplate_subtitle: Standard company description for press releases.
MediaKit.boilerplate_short_text: BizOps is an end-to-end Business Operating System that helps Indonesian companies digitalize operations from upstream to downstream. Combining the power of Open Source-based Enterprise technology with local regulatory compliance, BizOps offers a flexible, secure, and data-sovereign solution under PT Divistant Teknologi Indonesia.
MediaKit.boilerplate_standard_text: BizOps, developed by PT Divistant Teknologi Indonesia, is a 'Business Operating System' platform designed to bridge the gap between simple local accounting software and complex global ERP. With a 'Mobile-First' and 'Data Sovereignty' philosophy, BizOps provides integrated solutions for HR, Finance, Project Operations, and Supply Chain in one ecosystem. BizOps empowers Indonesian companies to have full control over their data through Self-Hosted options, while still enjoying the ease of use of modern mobile applications.
MediaKit.press_subtitle: For interview requests, expert quotes, or speaker invitations, please contact our communications team. We respond within 24 working hours.

Partners.hero_subtitle: Focus on your consulting and implementation expertise. Let us provide world-class ERP technology that is stable, secure, and easily customizable.
Partners.shift_old_desc: As a traditional consultant, your income is linearly limited by human working hours. Project ends, revenue stops. You're trapped in the 'Feast or Famine' cycle (sometimes busy with projects, sometimes quiet). Worse, service offerings are increasingly commoditized; clients easily switch to cheaper competitors or start replacing basic administrative services with AI. Without technology differentiation, your profit margins will continue to be eroded by price wars.
Partners.shift_new_desc: Future consultants don't just sell 'Advice', they sell 'Systems'. By owning your own ERP product, you embed systems into daily client operations. Transactional relationships turn into long-term 'sticky' strategic partnerships. You get Passive Income monthly from software licenses (SaaS), while still selling your premium consulting services on top. This is how to increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) up to 10x and create much higher business valuations.
Partners.calculator_subtitle: Simulate your revenue potential as a BizOps partner. Adjust parameters according to your business targets.
Partners.calculator_note: This calculation is an estimate. Actual revenue depends on selling price, client retention, and your sales effort.
Partners.benefits_subtitle: Benefits you get as an official BizOps partner.
Partners.benefit_1_desc: Build healthy, predictable cash flow. Client software subscriptions become 'passive income' for your company every month, covering basic office operating costs (Opex).
Partners.benefit_2_desc: Consulting clients using operational software from their consultant have 3x-5x longer retention rates. Their HR, Finance, and Project data is stored in 'your' system, creating a strong Moat.
Partners.benefit_3_desc: Building BizOps-class ERP requires a team of 20 developers and billions in costs. With this program, you 'rent' our research results instantly. Focus on sales and serving clients, let us do the coding.
Partners.benefit_4_desc: Software opens doors for other services. Client dashboard data shows worsening financial ratios? Offer cashflow consulting services. Messy inventory? Offer stock audit services.
Partners.persona_1_pain: Tired of chasing clients every month to request manual tax/bank statement evidence.
Partners.persona_1_solution: Give clients BizOps Whitelabel. Clients input operational data, you just pull neat financial reports from backend anytime.
Partners.persona_2_pain: Good at selling hardware (CCTV/Server/Fingerprint) but thin margins and one-off nature.
Partners.persona_2_solution: Bundle your CCTV/Fingerprint sales with BizOps software. Sell physical + digital security subscription solution.
Partners.persona_3_pain: Outsourcing management fee price competition is very tight. Clients demand field data transparency.
Partners.persona_3_solution: Win tenders by offering 'Digital Client Portal' (BizOps Whitelabel) for free or bundled. Killer USP against competitors.
Partners.cta_subtitle: Join 100+ partners who already trust BizOps to serve their clients.

StartupProgram.hero_subtitle: Audit-ready operational infrastructure for ambitious startups. Save burn rate with up to $5,000 in credits and access to Enterprise technology from Day 1.
StartupProgram.hero_trust: Trusted by 500+ High-Growth Startups in Indonesia
StartupProgram.perks_subtitle: We invest in your long-term success with a complete support ecosystem.
StartupProgram.perk_1_desc: BizOps Cloud usage credits for the first 12 months. Enough to cover operational costs for a team of up to 50 people without burdening your initial cashflow.
StartupProgram.perk_2_desc: Direct access ("Red Phone") to our Solution Architects. Consultation on system design, API integration, and security best practices to ensure your product is scalable from day one.
StartupProgram.perk_3_desc: Join an exclusive founder network. Get co-marketing opportunities, access to private networking events, and introductions to our investor partners.
StartupProgram.perk_4_desc: Dedicated resources and 24/7 priority support. No downtime when you go viral or when investors come visiting.
StartupProgram.perk_5_desc: Audit-ready infrastructure from day one. ISO 27001, GDPR compliant, and ready for investor due diligence at any time.
StartupProgram.perk_6_desc: Pitch deck templates, financial models, and access to an operational SOP library from 500+ successfully scaled startups.
StartupProgram.eligibility_subtitle: We're looking for startups that are serious about scaling and need solid infrastructure.
StartupProgram.eligibility_2: Funding stage: Pre-seed to Series A
StartupProgram.eligibility_3: Team of at least 3 full-time people
StartupProgram.eligibility_5: Product/service already live or in MVP stage
StartupProgram.apply_subtitle: Application process designed to be fast and hassle-free. We respect founder's time.
StartupProgram.apply_step_1_desc: Fill out a short form (5 minutes) about your startup
StartupProgram.apply_step_4_desc: Set up account and start building!
StartupProgram.faq_1_a: None. The credits given are 100% free. After credits run out or expire, you can choose to continue with startup-friendly pricing or migrate data out at no cost.
StartupProgram.faq_2_q: How long is the approval process?
StartupProgram.faq_2_a: Usually 2-3 business days. We'll review your application and do a quick call (15 minutes) to understand your technical needs.
StartupProgram.faq_3_a: Not at all. This is a pure acceleration program, not an investment. Your data remains 100% yours.
StartupProgram.faq_4_a: You get a 40% discount from regular pricing for the next 12 months. After that, normal pricing applies or you can negotiate an enterprise contract if you've scaled.
StartupProgram.cta_subtitle: Join 500+ startups that already trust BizOps to handle their operations.
